deleteLibrary.confirmDescEmpty: This permanently deletes the library "{{name}}". This action cannot be undone.

noSelectionHint: Choose a library from the sidebar to view and manage its media files, or add a new one.

automation.label: Automation
automation.hint: Watching and auto-scrape; organize stays manual

fieldTrailerPatternHint: Skip files whose names (with extension) match; empty disables. Default matches trailer
fieldBlacklistPatternsHint: One regex per line; matching files are skipped from scans and moved to .amane_trash on organize. Empty disables
fieldMinFileSizeHint: Videos smaller than this are skipped from scans and moved to .amane_trash on organize. Applies only to scanned video extensions, not images/NFO/subtitles. 0 disables
fieldMoveModeHint: How files are placed onto template paths during organize
fieldWriteNfoHint: Write Emby/Jellyfin compatible NFO during organize
fieldCopyResourcesHint: Sidecar types copied onto library paths; organize tasks may override
fieldVideoTemplateHint: Relative to library root or absolute; see placeholder badges below
fieldLinkTemplateHint: Leave empty to skip. When set, organize writes a strm or symlink here pointing at the real video; must be an absolute path outside the library root
fieldLinkModeHint: strm: write a .strm file (contents default to the video's absolute path; customizable below); symlink: a filesystem symlink to the mounted video
fieldStrmContentTemplateHint: Only applies when link mode is STRM. Empty = write the video's absolute path. Otherwise renders the single line inside the .strm, to match OpenList / MediaWarp AlistStrm. Note {video_relpath} strips the library root, not the mount point — if the root is deeper than the mount point, add the missing segments yourself (root /test/OD/VC → use /OD/VC/{video_relpath}). Must not contain newlines
fieldCdSuffixTemplateHint: Suffix for multi-part video filenames; use the {cd} placeholder for the part number
advancedTemplatesHint: Leave empty to use backend defaults (usually under {link_dir}). Absolute paths must stay under the library root or safe_dirs.

phases.source: From the source file (injected during organize)
phases.file: From the source file name (detected during organize)
phases.post_video: Available after video path is rendered; sidecar templates only
phases.subtitle: From the subtitle source file; subtitle template only
phases.strm: Organized video path with the library root stripped; STRM content template only

items.title: Title
items.ext: Extension of the file being placed, no dot. Video template uses the video; subtitle template uses that subtitle
items.raw_name: Source video filename without extension. e.g. A/B.mp4 → B
items.raw_dir: Source parent directory name. e.g. A/B/C.mp4 → B
items.mosaic: Censorship type, from filename or directory
items.video_dir: Directory of the rendered real video path; sidecar templates only
items.link_dir: Directory of the link file; same as {video_dir} when the link template is empty
items.raw_srt_name: Subtitle filename without extension. e.g. A/foo.zh.srt → foo.zh
items.video_path: Absolute path of the organized video (includes part suffix and collision rename); STRM content template only
items.video_relpath: Organized video path with the library root prefix stripped (POSIX separators, no leading /); STRM content template only. e.g. root /test → OD/VC/ABC-123/ABC-123.mp4; root /test/OD/VC → only ABC-123/ABC-123.mp4, so add /OD/VC/ in your template
